launcher.intro: Scans your load order for seasonal texture variants (e.g. rock01_AUT.dds next to rock01.dds) and generates the plugin + Data/Seasons/*.ini files for the Seasons of Skyrim SKSE plugin.

gameLocation.label: Game Location
gameLocation.mo2Warning: If you use Mod Organizer 2 or Vortex, run AutoSeasons through its tool list/dashboard, not by double-clicking the exe in Explorer - otherwise it only sees your real Data folder, not your installed mods, and silently produces an incomplete result.

blocklist.label: Seasonal Variation Blocklist
blocklist.help: Meshes matching a rule here are skipped by seasonal variation (useful for interior meshes, since Seasons of Skyrim only swaps records in exterior worldspaces). Wildcards (*) allowed, e.g. "*/interiors/*". Right click to add/remove rows.

editorIdKeywords.label: Season-Locked EditorID Keywords
editorIdKeywords.help: Records whose EditorID contains one of these words (case-insensitive) are skipped by seasonal variation entirely - useful for names that already signal a fixed season/biome, e.g. "Coast" or "River". Right click to add/remove rows.

removeGrassInWinter.label: Remove grass in winter if no winter variant exists

dryRun.label: Preview only (dry run) - scan and log what would happen, write nothing

missingGameLocation.title: Missing Game Location
missingGameLocation.message: Please select your game's install location.

seasonModOverrides.title: Season Mod Conflicts
seasonModOverrides.intro: AutoSeasons normally defers to another mod's own Data/Seasons ini whenever it already covers a record for a season - every mod below starts checked (respected). Uncheck a mod to have AutoSeasons overwrite it instead: it generates its own seasonal texture wherever it has the art, dropping that mod's own declaration entirely. When two respected mods both cover the same record, the one lower in the list wins (like Mod Organizer's own load order).
seasonModOverrides.noArtWarning: Unchecking a mod removes its swap for a record AutoSeasons has no seasonal art of its own for - it does NOT fall back to keeping that mod's swap.
seasonModOverrides.legend: Checked = keep this mod's own coverage   |   Unchecked = overwrite it with AutoSeasons' own texture   |   Position = priority order (bottom wins)
seasonModOverrides.noModsFound: No foreign season mods detected under Data/Seasons.

completion.title: AutoSeasons
completion.message: Generation complete - created %zu seasonal record(s) (%s). Don't forget to enable AutoSeasons.esp in your mod manager's plugin list if it isn't already active.
completion.zeroMessage: Generation complete, but 0 seasonal records were created. Double-check your game directory and blocklist/keyword settings - this usually means AutoSeasons didn't find the load order it expected.
completion.dryRunMessage: Preview complete - would create %zu seasonal record(s) (%s). Nothing was written to disk.
completion.zeroDryRunMessage: Preview complete, but 0 seasonal records would be created. Double-check your game directory and blocklist/keyword settings - this usually means AutoSeasons didn't find the load order it expected.
completion.conflictsSuffix: %zu record/season combination(s) are covered by multiple foreign mods with no priority set between them - see the log, or open "Manage Season Mod Conflicts" in the launcher to resolve which one should win.
